mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the CPI trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods analyzed.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the INDPRO trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the RSAFS trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the tight labor market combined with high interest rates signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the interaction trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals a robust labor market, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where the interaction trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where the GDPC1 trigger condition is met.
